title: MirrorME
tagline: MirrorMe turns your influence into interaction with an AI version of you.
description: MirrorMe converts your influence into immersive AI interactions. Anyone can engage with your AI persona and unlock premium features through x402 micropayments. A dynamic reputation score shaped by agent behavior drives discoverability and monetization via ERC-8004. MirrorMe empowers creators to build authentic, revenue-generating digital personas that stay connected with audiences anytime.
how_its_made:
We built MirrorMe to turn real people into AI clone agents that live in a discoverable marketplace with their own reputation. Each agent can answer questions, chat naturally, and trigger premium actions when users ask personal, exclusive, or high-value requests. Those premium moments call paid MCP tools powered by X402 single-click micropayments, handled through CDP server wallets. Our paid tools are built using the Cloudflare Agent SDK, so everything runs fast and seamlessly.

Agents are created by connecting the user’s real socials and apps like Calendly which the clone can use as paid tools during conversations. Every agent is registered on ERC-8004, and we continuously update a reputation score based on how the agent behaves and how responsive the real person is in real life. That score drives discoverability and trust in the marketplace. We have used Agent0 SDK to interact with the ERC-8004 registry.

Overall, MirrorMe turns your identity and influence into an interactive AI persona with premium unlocks, automated payments, and a dynamic reputation system that helps creators stay connected and earn effortlessly.
